display.purpose: Page titles ('Dashboard') — the largest type on any working surface. 30px/700.

title.purpose: Object names, meeting-hero title, panel titles. 22px/600.

body.purpose: Default text: descriptions, quotes, table cells. Prose capped 65-75ch. 14px/400.

metadata.purpose: Dense secondary data: shortcut chips, list values, meeting meta. 13px/500.

caption.purpose: The smallest metadata tier: timestamps, source captions, rail status. 11px/500.

micro.purpose: Section eyebrows and provenance micro-labels only. 10px/600 uppercase tracked.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Level 1 — normal white cards and controls: a very subtle lift.

shadows.name: raised
shadows.purpose: Level 2 — important cards (Meeting Hero); stronger elevation, no color change.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Level 3 — floating UI (dialogs, popovers, command palette), paired with blur.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Primary easing for reveals and state transitions.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: L2 state transitions: dialog/popover open-close, list reflow (180-250ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single most important action per surface. Solid blue fill, white label, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-foreground); border:none; border-radius:12px; padding:10px 20px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:var(--shadow-card); transition:background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action. White with a gray border, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; background:var(--surface-raised); color:var(--foreground); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:10px 20px; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:var(--shadow-card); transition:border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-alt); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Workspace search. White fill, 12px radius, leading icon, blue border-shift + soft ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; } .ds-field-icon { position:absolute; left:12px; color:var(--muted-foreground); pointer-events:none; } .ds-input { background:var(--surface-raised); color:var(--foreground); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:0 14px 0 36px; height:40px; font-size:0.875rem; width:288px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 40%, transparent); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Meeting status / review outcome. Full-radius pill, neutral by default; a colored tone only for real status.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:var(--surface-sunken); color:var(--muted-foreground); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:9999px; padding:2px 10px; font-size:0.6875rem; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Sidebar navigation row. Muted at rest; active = soft-blue wash with blue label and icon (no side-stripe). Route-derived.
components.html: Dashboard
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:10px; color:var(--muted-foreground); font-size:0.875rem; text-decoration:none; transition:color 0.15s, background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color:var(--foreground); background:var(--surface-sunken); } .ds-nav-item--active { color:var(--accent-emphasis); background:var(--accent-subtle); font-weight:500; } .ds-nav-item--active svg { color:var(--accent-emphasis); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Level 1 content card: solid white, 1px hairline, 16px radius, 24px padding, a tiny shadow. Never glass, never nested.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--surface-raised); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px; padding:24px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-card); }

narrative.overview: Meridian is the software a founder, chief of staff, or director opens the hour before a board meeting and instantly trusts. The interface is a calm, well-lit desk: a soft neutral page, white cards that sit like physical sheets, hairline structure, and exactly one trustworthy blue that appears only where it means 'do this'. It is light-mode-first with 95% neutral surfaces and 5% semantic color; violet is reserved as the Institutional-Memory identity. Trust here is legibility under scrutiny, not atmosphere — reduce flatness with spacing and elevation, not more color.
keyCharacteristics: Light-mode only, 95% neutral / 5% semantic: color communicates meaning, never decoration.
Blue #2563EB is the one action color (buttons, active nav, links, focus, selection, calendar events).
Violet #6D28D9 is reserved for Institutional Memory surfaces only — never a button or nav.
White cards on a soft neutral page, separated by hairlines and a very subtle shadow; three elevation levels.
Inter throughout; hierarchy from weight and size, not font contrast. WCAG 2.2 AA is a hard floor.

rules.name: The One-Action Rule
rules.body: Blue means action. It appears on the primary action, active nav, links, focus, and selection — and nowhere else. Blue to 'brighten up' a panel is a bug.

rules.name: The Memory-Only Violet Rule
rules.body: Violet appears only on institutional-memory surfaces (graph health, provenance, memory metrics/trend charts). Violet on a button, nav, or generic accent is a bug.

rules.name: The Neutral-Page Rule
rules.body: Page base is neutral #F7F8FA and cards are white; separation comes from hairlines and a subtle shadow, never a tint.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Type is a fixed rem scale, never fluid clamp(). A heading that shrinks in a sidebar is a regression.

rules.name: The Blur-Is-Chrome-or-Floating Rule
rules.body: Backdrop-blur / translucency appears only on the header, the AI rail (anchored chrome), and Level-3 floating UI. Dashboard content cards stay solid white; the left nav is solid.

dos: Do keep blue to action only (<=5-10% of any screen) and violet to memory only.
Do convey depth by tonal layering (neutral page -> white card) first, subtle shadow second; use three levels.
Do derive nav/tab active state from the current route (usePathname).
Do give every interactive element a visible, non-color-only focus ring and a full keyboard path.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every transition; keep state transitions 150-250ms.
Do signal status with a shape/label/icon in addition to color.
Do keep information density high: tight legible rows and short paths to common actions.
donts: Don't style like an enterprise board portal (Diligent, Boardvantage) or a generic SaaS dashboard (gradient hero-metric tiles, identical icon-heading-text card grids).
Don't use violet for buttons or navigation, or blue for success/warning — each color has one meaning.
Don't use gradients, neon, glow-as-default, or glass on content cards.
Don't ship sci-fi copy — write plainly ('Loading…', 'No conflicts pending review').
Don't hardcode off-token hex or palette-step colors in components.
Don't use a border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
